parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app path. Per the decision rules, any record under Examples/ or SampleApp/ triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The duplicate 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.init' in the sample app is a local copy for demonstration purposes; extracting it into shared production code would couple the DebugPanel production package to sample-app semantics. No refactor is warranted.
